svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: light-dark(#ffffff, var(--ge-dark-color, #121212)); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" agent="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64; rv:141.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/141.0" version="28.0.7" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="wto0xpUeJBbyqjHOOY5S"> <mxGraphModel dx="4203" dy="2138" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{"data":"@startuml FoodDeliveryMicroservices
!theme plain
skinparam linetype ortho
skinparam componentStyle rectangle
skinparam packageStyle rectangle

skinparam component {
 BackgroundColor<<service>> LightBlue
 BackgroundColor<<database>> LightYellow
 BackgroundColor<<message>> Orange
 BackgroundColor<<observability>> LightGreen
 BackgroundColor<<external>> Pink
 BackgroundColor<<gateway>> LightCyan
}

skinparam database {
 BackgroundColor LightYellow
}

skinparam queue {
 BackgroundColor Orange
}

' Client Layer
actor \"Client Applications\" as Client

' Gateway Layer
component \"YARP API Gateway\" as Gateway <<gateway>>

' Service Layer - horizontal spacing
package \"Core Microservices\" {
 component \"Identity Service\" as Identity <<service>>
 component \"Customers Service\" as Customers <<service>>
 component \"Catalogs Service\" as Catalogs <<service>>
 component \"Orders Service\" as Orders <<service>>
 component \"Payment Service\" as Payment <<service>>
}

' Message Processing Layer
package \"Message Processing\" {
 component \"Message Processor\" as MessageProcessor <<message>>
 component \"Outbox Processor\" as OutboxProcessor <<message>>
 component \"Inbox Processor\" as InboxProcessor <<message>>
 component \"Internal Processor\" as InternalProcessor <<message>>
}

' Infrastructure Layer
queue \"RabbitMQ\" as RabbitMQ <<message>>
database \"Redis Cache\" as Redis
database \"EventStoreDB\" as EventStoreDB

' Write Databases Layer
package \"Write Databases PostgreSQL\" {
 database \"Identity DB\" as IdentityDB
 database \"Customers DB\" as CustomersDB
 database \"Catalogs DB\" as CatalogsDB
 database \"Orders DB\" as OrdersDB
 database \"Payment DB\" as PaymentDB
 database \"Message Store\" as MessageDB
}

' Read Databases Layer
package \"Read Databases\" {
 database \"Identity Read MongoDB\" as IdentityReadDB
 database \"Customers Read MongoDB\" as CustomersReadDB
 database \"Catalogs Read MongoDB\" as CatalogsReadDB
 database \"Orders Read MongoDB\" as OrdersReadDB
 database \"Payment Read MongoDB\" as PaymentReadDB
 database \"Search Elasticsearch\" as SearchDB
}

' Observability Layer
package \"Observability Stack\" {
 component \"OpenTelemetry\" as OpenTelemetry <<observability>>
 database \"Elasticsearch\" as Elastic <<observability>>
 component \"Kibana\" as Kibana <<observability>>
 database \"Prometheus\" as Prometheus <<observability>>
 component \"Grafana\" as Grafana <<observability>>
 component \"Jaeger\" as Jaeger <<observability>>
 database \"Loki\" as Loki <<observability>>
 database \"Tempo\" as Tempo <<observability>>
 component \"Zipkin\" as Zipkin <<observability>>
}

' External Services
component \"Ethereal Email\" as EtherealEmail <<external>>

' ========== CONNECTIONS ==========

' Client to Gateway
Client --> Gateway

' Gateway to Services
Gateway --> Identity
Gateway --> Customers
Gateway --> Catalogs
Gateway --> Orders
Gateway --> Payment

' Services to Write Databases
Identity --> IdentityDB
Customers --> CustomersDB
Catalogs --> CatalogsDB
Orders --> OrdersDB
Payment --> PaymentDB

' Services to Read Databases (CQRS Read Side)
Identity ..> IdentityReadDB
Customers ..> CustomersReadDB
Catalogs ..> CatalogsReadDB
Orders ..> OrdersReadDB
Payment ..> PaymentReadDB

' Event Sourcing
Orders --> EventStoreDB
Payment --> EventStoreDB

' Message Processing
MessageProcessor --> MessageDB
OutboxProcessor --> MessageDB
InboxProcessor --> MessageDB
InternalProcessor --> MessageDB

' Services to Message Broker
Identity --> RabbitMQ
Customers --> RabbitMQ
Catalogs --> RabbitMQ
Orders --> RabbitMQ
Payment --> RabbitMQ

' Message Processing Flow
OutboxProcessor --> RabbitMQ
RabbitMQ --> InboxProcessor
RabbitMQ --> MessageProcessor

' Cache Connections
Identity --> Redis
Customers --> Redis
Catalogs --> Redis
Orders --> Redis
Payment --> Redis

' Search Functionality
Catalogs --> SearchDB
Orders --> SearchDB

' Email Service
Identity --> EtherealEmail
Customers --> EtherealEmail
Orders --> EtherealEmail

' Observability Connections
Identity --> OpenTelemetry
Customers --> OpenTelemetry
Catalogs --> OpenTelemetry
Orders --> OpenTelemetry
Payment --> OpenTelemetry
Gateway --> OpenTelemetry

' Telemetry Storage
OpenTelemetry --> Prometheus
OpenTelemetry --> Jaeger
OpenTelemetry --> Loki
OpenTelemetry --> Tempo

' Direct Logging (Serilog to Elasticsearch)
Identity --> Elastic
Customers --> Elastic
Catalogs --> Elastic
Orders --> Elastic
Payment --> Elastic
Gateway --> Elastic

' Visualization
Elastic --> Kibana
Prometheus --> Grafana
Jaeger --> Zipkin

' Synchronous Communication (REST/gRPC)
Identity <-> Customers
Customers <-> Orders
Catalogs <-> Orders
Orders <-> Payment

' Read Model Synchronization via Events
RabbitMQ ..> IdentityReadDB
RabbitMQ ..> CustomersReadDB
RabbitMQ ..> CatalogsReadDB
RabbitMQ ..> OrdersReadDB
RabbitMQ ..> PaymentReadDB

@enduml","format":"svg"}" id="4XqCEtfjZQGX_zd2EIey-358"> <mxCell style="shape=image;noLabel=1;verticalAlign=top;aspect=fixed;imageAspect=0;image=data:image/svg+xml,;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="-70" y="210" width="3065" height="694" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
